name: Isolated Patients Travel and Accommodation Assistance Scheme (IPTAAS)
summary: NSW subsidy towards travel and accommodation when you must travel 100km or more for specialist treatment not available locally.
who: Travel at least 100km one way, or 200km in a week over multiple trips, to the nearest approved health service
how: Apply online (Digital ID or MFA needed) or send the paper form with invoices to your local IPTAAS office
catches: Applications must be submitted within 12 months of your discharge or appointment end date.
Concession card holders may get advance travel help (per the assessment guidelines).

evidence.quote: IPTAAS provides financial assistance from the NSW Government towards your travel and accommodation costs
Applications must be submitted within 12 months of your hospitalisation discharge or appointment end date.
